newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales slow in limited test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales slow in limited test - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to $0.25 per cwt higher in limited test. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 2,000 slaughter steers and 2,400 slaughter heifers. Week to date 23,400 head confirmed including 15,500 head of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 64.00-64.25. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3
Wk to date - 23,400 last week - 76,900 last year - 28,100
